name: nmap
description: A network discovery and security scanning tool: finds live hosts, open ports, running services, and operating system fingerprints.

flags.description: TCP connect scan of 1000 common ports on the target.
-p PORTS: all 65535 ports / specific ports or ranges.
Probe open ports to determine service versions.
Ping sweep only: find live hosts without port scanning.

examples.explanation: Scans three ports and fingerprints the exact software versions behind them.
Scans all 65535 ports quickly — use this when a service hides on a non-standard port.

about: nmap is the industry-standard scanner for authorized security assessment and network inventory. Its NSE scripting engine (hundreds of scripts) can enumerate services, check for vulnerabilities, and gather banners. Scanning hosts you do not own or lack permission for may be illegal and will trip intrusion detection systems.
useCases: Verify firewall rules do what you think.
Security assessment of systems you are authorized to test.
mistakes: Believing "filtered" means closed — filtered means a firewall dropped the probe; the port may still be open.
warnings: Only scan systems you own or have explicit permission to test. Port scanning is treated as hostile activity on most networks.
distroNotes: Install via package manager (nmap package). Windows builds exist; some features (raw packet scans) are Linux/macOS best.
